h1: Custom Color Changing Ink for Silicone & Stadium Cups
lead: We create colour-changing cup designs for silicone cups and stadium cups. Bring your logo, pattern or campaign idea. Our team develops the design and visual mockup free of charge, then makes a physical sample showing the colour-change effect.
html:
Questions Before You Order

What are your payment terms?

We require a 30% deposit. The remaining 70% must be paid in full before shipment.

Which payment methods do you accept?

We accept T/T (bank transfer), Western Union and Alipay.

Which currencies can I pay in?

We accept USD, CNY, EUR and GBP. Other currencies can also be arranged for your order.

Which trade terms do you offer?

We offer EXW (Ex Works), FOB Shenzhen, C&F and DDP. The trade term is agreed with you for each order.

What is the difference between a color-changing cup mockup and a physical sample?

The mockup shows your proposed artwork and reveal concept. A physical sample shows the color response on the actual silicone or stadium cup. Use the approved sample as the reference for the production design.

Which part of the design should I send for a color-changing cup project?

Send the selected silicone or stadium cup, your fixed artwork and the appearance you want to reveal. Our factory team develops the design proposal and product mockup from those elements.

Compare the Relevant Products and Service

Email Us for Free Design and a Project Quote
